recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中造血細胞與脂肪之間夾雜成片大型細胞，細胞質淡染、呈細網狀或泡泡狀（bubbly），核小而居中或偏位，為泡沫狀巨噬細胞浸潤，提示儲積症（如 Niemann-Pick）。
features: Sheets and clusters of large polygonal macrophages interspersed among hematopoietic cells and adipocytes
Abundant pale cytoplasm with fine reticulated, bubbly (multivacuolated) texture
Small round to oval, centrally or eccentrically placed nuclei
Sharp cell borders giving a mosaic pattern where macrophages are confluent
Residual hematopoietic cells including erythroid and myeloid precursors and a megakaryocyte
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy section shows a hypercellular marrow in which the hematopoietic elements are extensively infiltrated by sheets of large macrophages. These cells have abundant pale, finely vacuolated bubbly cytoplasm with distinct borders and small central to eccentric nuclei. Residual trilineage hematopoiesis and fat spaces are present. Findings are consistent with infiltration by foamy storage histiocytes, suggestive of a lipid storage disorder such as Niemann-Pick disease; correlation with aspirate morphology, enzyme assay, and genetic testing is required.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells on trephine have striated, fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm that is PAS-positive, rather than finely bubbly vacuoles.
Mycobacteria-laden histiocytes have striated/granular pale cytoplasm and are packed with acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
Carcinoma cells show nuclear atypia with nucleoli, form cohesive nests with delicate vasculature, and are cytokeratin positive and CD68/CD163 negative.

ddx.dx: Crystal-storing or lipid-laden histiocytosis in lymphoproliferative disorders
ddx.vs: These show crystalline or eosinophilic inclusions with an associated clonal lymphoid or plasma cell population.
